notes: meta.json contains export-level data only; visual metadata was inferred from thumbnail.png and exported bitmap assets.
canvas.fig is a compact binary export and was not directly readable as document JSON in this workspace.

canvas.artboardPattern: Multiple tall mobile screens in a horizontal strip, designed around a dark smart-home control dashboard.

logo.usage: OKAS wordmark in the app header and splash/auth branding.

roomPhotography.usage: Image-led room cards with dark overlay and rounded top corners.

controlImagery.usage: RGB color wheel and speaker/product-like control references for bottom sheets.

home.header: Compact brand row with OKAS logo, HomeKit label, and right-aligned connection pill.
home.hero: Welcome text followed by a large Smart Home title and inline Add Room action.
home.rooms: Horizontal image cards, 220px wide, 200px tall, rounded 20px, image top area about 110px.
home.activeLoads: Horizontal stat cards, 88px wide, icon in tinted rounded square, label, count.

loads.filters: Horizontal pill chips at 46px height. Selected chip uses cyan fill; unselected chips use translucent surface.
loads.grid: 3-column grid, 12px gaps, 0.75 aspect ratio. Each tile contains icon, status dot, capability label, device name, and power pill.

rooms.list: Vertical room cards with top image, load count, load icon chips, and glass surface styling.
rooms.detailSheet: Draggable bottom sheet with large top radius, handle, title, and load tiles.

controlSheets.surface: Raised dark teal glass sheet with 28px top radius.
controlSheets.header: Title left and master power switch right.
controlSheets.actions: Cancel and Save buttons in a 2-column row.
controlSheets.controls: Large numeric value readout, white/cyan slider track, segmented mode controls where needed.

profileGuestManagement.preservation: Profile tab and GuestManagementScreen remain functional.
profileGuestManagement.visualTreatment: Guest cards use the same raised dark surface, cyan active accents, amber revoke control, rose delete/revoked states.
